messages.subject: Installing RStan on Windows XP
parts:
Hi Stan Users,

Thanks in advance.

May I request you to assist me for the following please.

I am trying to install RStan on Windows XP.

1. I have successfully installed CmdStan on Windows XP and it is working fine.

2. Now I am trying to install RStan. 

    - I have installed R-3.0.3 on windows XP

    - I have installed inline and Rcpp

    - I like to take this approach to install RStan. I have downloaded rstan_2.2.0.tar.gz in a local drive (say, D). Now how can I install it?

Once again, thank you very much for the time you have given.

Regards,

Deb
